title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy form-action allows every origin
description: The policy let a form post anywhere. Form submission does not need script execution, so a single markup injection turns the page into a delivery mechanism for whatever the user types next, including passwords, to any host. The finding is the unbounded destination list.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: Credential and data exfiltration through form submission; MEDIUM severity.
